summary_en: Full-year dividend forecast for fiscal year ending March 2027 raised to 105 yen per share from 102 yen, with year-end dividend increased 3 yen to 54 yen from 51 yen, reflecting upward revision of profit forecast driven by better-than-planned sales progress and improved profitability from cost reduction and price hikes.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Consolidated Business Forecast and Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase) for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027
translation_en_brief:
TOKUDEN CO., LTD. revised its full-year dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027, raising the year-end dividend from 51 yen to 54 yen per share, an increase of 3 yen. Combined with the interim dividend of 51 yen already recorded, the total full-year dividend for fiscal 2027 is now forecast at 105 yen per share, up from the previously announced 102 yen.

The revision reflects an upward correction to the company's overall profit forecast. The company's consolidated business forecast for fiscal 2027 was raised based on stronger-than-planned sales progress in both its construction engineering business and environmental equipment business segments, coupled with improved profitability driven by cost reduction initiatives and progress in price hikes to customers.

The company stated that stable dividend continuation is one of its highest management priorities. The dividend policy targets a consolidated shareholder capital dividend yield (DOE) of approximately 2 percent, taking into account the company's business performance and future business development plans. The revision of the period-end dividend reflects this policy framework applied to the improved earnings outlook for fiscal 2027.
